InfinityShop - The Dynamic and Intelligent Store
Tired of static stores where prices never change? Introducing InfinityShop, a revolutionary plugin that transforms your server's economy into a living, pulsating market based on the law of supply and demand.

Each item in the store has a stock that fluctuates in real time. When players buy an item, the stock decreases and its price rises. When they sell, the stock increases and the price falls. This creates a realistic and challenging economic experience, encouraging players to explore and farm different resources.

Key Features:

• Compatibility with Bedrock Edition: The server has a UI (User Interface) system where any store you create and the player accesses through Bedrock will be converted into a UI interface.

• 100% Dynamic Economy: Prices adjust automatically based on player purchases and sales. Never worry about a stagnant economy again!

• Market Alerts: The plugin globally announces when an item is priced too high ("BOOM" - great for selling!) or too low ("CRASH" - the perfect opportunity to buy!).

• Intuitive Graphical User Interface (GUI): A category-organized shop that's easy to navigate and use. Players can buy and sell with just a few clicks.

• Fully Configurable: Create your own categories, add any item, set base prices, economy sensitivity, and customize all messages through easy-to-edit YAML files.

• Simplified Selling Commands: Allow your players to easily sell items with the /sell command and even sell all items of a type at once to empty their inventory.

• Multi-Language Support: The plugin comes with translations and allows you to easily add new languages.

With InfinityShop, you encourage players to actively participate in the economy, farming low-supply resources and selling high-supply ones. Give your server a new lease on life and create an economic challenge for your community!

 

InfinityShop Commands


Here is a list of all available commands and their corresponding permissions:
Player Commands
•
/shop
◦
Description: Opens the main shop menu, allowing players to browse categories and items.
◦
Permission: infinityshop.cmd.shop (granted to all by default).
•
/sell <all|hand>
◦
Description: Allows for the quick selling of items.
▪
/sell all: Sells all sellable items in your inventory.
▪
/sell hand: Sells all items currently held in your hand.
◦
Permission: infinityshop.cmd.sell (granted to all by default).
Admin Commands
•
/infinityshop reload
◦
Description: Reloads all plugin configuration files, including config.yml, categorias.yml, and language files. Essential for applying changes without a server restart.
◦
Permission: infinityshop.admin

 
Requirements:


• [InfinityCore] https://modrinth.com/plugin/infinitycore (essential plugin for using my plugins)

• Spigot, Paper, or Forks server (version 1.21+).

• Vault-compatible savings plugin (e.g., EssentialsX, etc.).

• (Optional) ProtocolLib for additional features.

• (Optional) FloodGate & GeyserMC if you want to use the multi-platform system


Please help keep the plugin updated, as it doesn't have a premium version system to ensure availability for everyone :)
